column1: # STAGE 1 of the GN161 residual-30 closure - EVIDENCE VALIDATION AND PROPOSED DOMAINS.
# OPUS, 2026-09-15, for OPUS-REQ-SWE2-EC7-GN161-RESIDUAL-30-VALIDATE-APPLY-RECERTIFY.
# WHAT THIS IS: for each of the 30 bodies carrying no GFZ.V121.CodeDomain at the certified GN161
# parent, the passage that says what it does, a verdict, and a PROPOSED domain. The set is exactly
# residual-30-GN161.tsv's (sorted diff empty, no duplicates).
# PRE-IMPORT CHECK, 2026-09-16 (OPUS). Mechanical only - it says the input will not fail on its
# own shape. It is NOT a certification of the proposals, which OPUS wrote and must not certify.
#   * 30 rows, verdict `validated` on all 30, every column filled on all 30.
#   * 30 DISTINCT proposed domains - no two rows propose the same one.
#   * ZERO collide with a domain already in the graph. Measured against the 998 distinct
#     GFZ.V121.CodeDomain values in Tools/work/graph/functions.tsv, whose `tags` column is
#     SEMICOLON separated. The first attempt split it on commas, which read each whole tag string
#     as one domain and reported a zero that was luck rather than a measurement; the number above
#     is from the corrected split.
#   * check_residual_depth at HEAD, now runnable for the first time (81362e81), bands all 30 as
#     DESCRIBED with CONTESTED 0 and NEEDS-THE-BODY-READ 0 - so the standing "BODY-READ 30"
#     premise is measurably empty, not merely stale.
# RE-CHECKED AT HEAD 16c280f3, 2026-09-16 (OPUS), because the check above names no commit and HEAD
# moved many times the same day. UNCHANGED, every clause re-measured rather than assumed:
#   * 30 rows, `validated` on all 30, zero empty cells in any column.
#   * 30 DISTINCT proposed domains.
#   * ZERO collide with the 998 distinct GFZ.V121.CodeDomain values now in the graph
#     (semicolon split, the corrected one).
#   * The address set is IDENTICAL to the unresolved list exported today from the certified GN161
#     parent batch_R109/post.fas2 - 38,161 functions, owner 9,409, domains 28,137, unresolved 30,
#     overlap 0 - so this file still describes the population it was written for.
#   THE INPUT IS IMPORT-READY AT THIS HEAD. That is a statement about SHAPE, not about whether the
#   proposals are right, which remains SWE2-AUDIT-SEM's to judge and not OPUS's.
# OUTCOME, 2026-09-16 (OPUS) - THE THREE SENTENCES BELOW ARE NOW SUPERSEDED AND KEPT AS RECORD.
# SWE2-EC7 applied all 30 rows and sealed the certified GN162 parent (...GN162_100P000_2026-09-16.gzf,
# sha 59629b9b...cf92). Verified INDEPENDENTLY by OPUS at work/verify_GN162 rather than taken from
# the commit subject: V121_COVERAGE internal=38161 owner=9409 finalNo=585 codeDomain=28167 overlap=0
# explicit=38161 unresolved=0 pct=100.00000; residual_addrs.txt is one byte; embedded_exe.bin sha256
# 73461d08...21f8, the authorized image, exact match.
# THE ORDERING BELOW WAS FOLLOWED AND IT PAID. SWE2-AUDIT-SEM's PRE-BATCH review returned ACCEPT,
# 30/30 domains stand as written, with one fold-in - 0024B580's evidence cite the-unresolved-158.md
# :1164-1240 -> :1280-1347 - and it was applied TO THIS TSV BEFORE the batch. Arriving at stage 4 it
# would have cost a re-import of a certified parent; arriving first it cost one cell.
# THE GATE IS SEALED - 2026-09-16, and ONLY because the third party reproduced it. Stage 4 has
# LANDED. SWE2-AUDIT-SEM took its OWN fresh import of GN162 into work/auditsem_stage4 and OPUS
# verified that import's artifacts directly rather than reading the checkpoint note:
#     embedded_exe.bin   sha256 73461d0896204b1c259c52f61aef4efbc95a2ffc388cadb36493d5d1d89721f8
#                        - the authorized image, exact match
#     snapshot.fas2      sha256 16a2a832...  - the hash AUDIT-SEM reported, reproduced byte-exact
#     residual_addrs.txt ONE BYTE - empty
#     coverage.tsv       internal=38161 owner=9409 finalNo=585 codeDomain=28167 overlap=0
#                        explicit=38161 unresolved=0 pct=100.00000
# and 30/30 applied domains exact, fence against the certified GN161 clean.
# ~~THE GATE IS NOT SEALED. Stage 4, independent re-certification, has NOT landed. OPUS proposed~~
# ~~these domains and SWE2-EC7 applied them, so neither may close it. Until AUDIT-SEM independently~~
# ~~reproduces unresolved = 0 with the hashes and invariants, `unresolved = 0` is EC7's measurement~~
# ~~confirmed by OPUS reading EC7's artifacts - two of the three parties and not an independent one.~~
# THE STANDARD WAS MET RATHER THAN WAIVED, and that is the whole point of keeping the struck text
# above. The figure `unresolved = 0` was TRUE for days before it was SEALED, and the difference was
# never the number - it was who had reproduced it. OPUS proposed the 30 domains and SWE2-EC7 applied
# them, so a seal signed by either would have been the author certifying the author. What changed is
# that a party outside the work rebuilt it from the certified parent and got the same bytes.
# AND THE LAST OPEN OBJECTION WAS AUDIT-SEM'S OWN, FOLDED IN BEFORE THE BATCH RATHER THAN AFTER:
# AUDITSEM-CONTRA-EC7-RESIDUAL30-B580CITE found row 0024B580 citing the-unresolved-158.md:1164-1240,
# which is the tail of section 13 and not the body read. The read is at 1280-1347. The row now cites
# 1280-1347 and line 1280 is the heading "`0024B580` read - the one residual whose entry nothing
# names". The domain was never in question; an evidence range that points at the wrong section makes
# a citation unverifiable for the next reader, which is reason enough to fix it before importing.
# WHAT SEALING THIS DOES NOT DO: it does not advance the FINAL-AUDIT streak. final_audits is 0/30 and
# pass 22 is RED on an unaccounted neighbour in effect-mesh-records-kind-54.md. One gate closing is
# not thirty passes clean on one commit.
# ~~WHAT THIS IS NOT: an application. Nothing is tagged in the GZF by this file, no ledger figure~~
# ~~moves, and `unresolved` is still 30.~~ Stages 2 and 3 (batch application, fence, fresh-import
# certification) are SWE2-EC7's. Stage 4, independent re-certification, is SWE2-AUDIT-SEM's: OPUS
# ORDERING CORRECTED 2026-09-16 (OPUS), AGAINST MY OWN STAGING ABOVE. The 109 pass did NOT review
# after applying: residual-109-classification.tsv's header records "AUDIT-SEM narrowing applied
# BEFORE batch", and two of the 109 proposals were changed by the reviewer - 002F0280 and 0028AAA0.
# THE REVIEW BELONGS BEFORE THE BATCH, and the reason is mechanical rather than procedural: a
# narrowing that arrives at stage 4 lands in a parent that has already been written and certified,
# so it costs a re-import rather than an edit. On the 109 that would have been two rows of rework.
# So: SWE2-AUDIT-SEM reviews these 30 PROPOSALS first, any narrowing is folded in, and SWE2-EC7
# batches the result - then the post-import certification is a confirmation rather than a discovery.
# No new task is filed for this. AUDIT-SEM's queue is around seventy deep and OPUS-NOTICE-AUDITSEM-
# RESIDUAL30-STAGE4-INCOMING already exists; what was missing was not a task but the ORDER, written
# where the next reader of this file will stand.
# proposed these domains and must not certify them.
# THE RULE APPLIED is the-unresolved-158.md's "What a citation has to say before it can carry a
# CodeDomain" (OPUS, 2026-09-15): a citation establishes one when it says WHAT THE FUNCTION DOES -
# a prototype, a verb about named state, or a position in a named pipeline - and not when it only
# names the function or records that it was not followed. Noun-phrase roles count (the 2026-09-14
# correction); a pass-22 crossing citation never does.
# VERDICT is `validated` or `failed`. All 30 validate; none was forced. Where the evidence is thin
# the DEPTH column says so rather than the verdict being softened, and the domain is coarsened:
#   0018EEE0 and 001D72F0 rest on ONE sentence each;
#   002AF340's return value is explicitly "not established" and UQ-366 is open about it, so its
#     domain names only the layout-pass family;
#   0024B580's own page refuses authored meaning ("Structure, not meaning"), so its domain is
#     STRUCTURAL and names no purpose;
#   0028BB50 and 001D72F0 are coarse: what the nodes are, and what the pass draws, are not stated.
# THOSE FIVE ARE WHERE AN INDEPENDENT REVIEWER SHOULD START.
# depth: body-read (a section decodes the whole body), section (a section decodes the mechanism),
#        table-row (a census row: noun-phrase role plus mechanism), line (one sentence).
